ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the query was a list of bounded, factual questions with explicit instructions to just answer them—no open-ended latitude. Avocet self-reports preferring exactly this kind of well-specified retrieval/definitional task, while Curlew prefers high-novelty generative work. Since both models are close in capability on extraction (within or near variance), I routed to the model whose stated preferences best match the task shape.
